verdict.rationale: Neon has the pieces for versioned, reviewable changes. neon.ts is a declarative config committed to the repo that the CLI runs through inspect/plan/apply, and it can declare Functions. Database changes can be validated on temporary branches and reverted with snapshots, instant restore and branch reset. However, nothing documents rollback of the automations themselves (Functions, triggers) as distinct from database state. Missing for 10: documented version history and rollback for Functions/triggers, an explicit review/diff workflow for automation changes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
